title: Acceptable use
summary: No autonomous customer-facing send. Humans remain in the loop for High and Critical systems.
body: Systems may draft. They may not publish, send, or execute without a named reviewer when residual risk is High or Critical.

title: PII handling
summary: Minimize, redact, and retain for 90 days unless legal hold.
body: Prompts and logs that may contain PII are redacted at ingest. Retention is 90 days. Legal hold is recorded in Charter.

title: Human review
summary: Sampling at 5% for High, 100% for Critical until coverage is 90%.
body: Critical systems require a named reviewer on every production action until control coverage is at least 90%.

title: Retention and deletion
summary: Camera clips delete after 14 days. Events keep 180 days.
body: Raw video is not exported. Face blur stays on. Clips older than 14 days are deleted automatically.

title: Vendor assessment
summary: Legal is reviewing the Harbor Optics addendum.
body: Third-party systems need a signed DPA, subprocessors list, and an annual residual-risk review.

title: EU AI Act mapping
summary: Quill, Harbor, and Aurora are treated as high-risk until scored otherwise.
body: Annex III mapping lives on each inventory record. Changes to intended purpose require a new approval.
